content: Seekeemen Ooraxida Caaqo Qaala
Hessafe guye Iyaasoy Isra7eele qommota ubbaa Seekeemen shiishshides. Cimata, kaaleththizayta, daannatanne pirdizayta ubbaa xeygides; isttika Xoossa sinth shiiqida.
Iyaasoy deraa ubbaas, «GODAA Isra7eele Xoossay, ‹Kase intte aawati Abrahaamenne Naakoore aawa Taara gujjidi Efiraaxise shaafappe he pinththan de7ida; istti hara eeqa xoossatas goynnida.
Tani gidikko intte aawa Abrahaame Efiraaxise shaafas he pinththafe ehadis; Kanaane biittankka kaaleththadis. Iza zereththatakka darsadis; Yisaaqakka izas immadis.
Yisaaqaska Yaaqoobenne Eesawe immadis. Eesawes gezzetiza Seyre biitta xinxxo histta immadis; Yaaqoobeynne iza nayti gidikko duge Gibxe bida.
« ‹Hessafe guye Musenne Aaroone kiittadis; ta ehida boshan Gibxeta un7eththada inttena heeppe kessadis.
Tani intte aawata Gibxeppe kessiin Zo7o abbaako yideta; Gibxeti para-gaaretaninne toga asatan inttena Zo7o abbaa gakkanaas oykkana kaallida.

Intte aawati maado demmanaas taakko waassida; tani isttafenne Gibxetappe giddon dhuma yeggadis; histtada abbay istta bolla simmana malanne istta mittana mala ooththadis. Tani Gibxeta bolla ooththidayssa intte intte ayfen be7ideta. Intteka bazzon daro wode de7ideta.

« ‹Hessafe guye Yordaanoose shaafappe arshey mokkizaso baggara diza Amooreta biitta tani inttena ehadis. Istti inttenara olettiin tani istta intte kushen aaththa immadis; tani istta intte sinththafe dhayssadis; qasse intte istta biitta laattideta.
Hessafe guye Mo7aabe biitta kawo Xipoora naa Balaaqey Isra7eele olanaas dendides; inttena yiidi doqqana mala Bi7oore naa Balaames kiita yeddides.
Tani gidikko Balaame siyana koyabeekke; hessa gishshas izi inttena zaari zaari anjjides; tanikka inttena Baalaaqe kusheppe ashshadis.

« ‹Heeppe intte Yordaanoose shaafa pinnidi Iyarkko yideta; Amooreti, Paarizeti, Kanaaneti, Hiiteti, Gergeseti, Hiiwetinne Yaabuseti inttenara olettida mala Iyarkko asay inttenara olettides; gido attiin tani istta intte kushen aaththa immadis.
Inttefe sinththe kazhe kiittada isttanne Amoore kawo nam7ata intte sinththafe gooddadis. Hayssi ubbay haniday intte mashshaninne intte wondafen gidenna.
Intte daaburontta biittanne intte keexxontta katamata tani inttes immadis; hekko intte tokkontta woyne ayfenne wogara ayfe meeta› gides.

«Hessa gishshas ha7ikka GODAAS yayyite; kumeththa wozinappe ammaneteththan izas haarettite; kase intte aawati Efiraaxise shaafappe he pinththaninne Gibxe biittan goynnida eeqa xoossata inttefe haassite; GODAAS xalla goynnite.

GODAAS goynoy koshshontta miish misati inttes beettiko kase intte aawati shaafappe he pinththan dishe goynnida eeqa xoossata woykko ha7i intte diza Amooreti goynniza xoossata goynnana gidikko intte goynnanayssa hach doorite; taninne ta keeththa asay gidikko GODAAS goynnana» gides.
Histtiin asay zaaridi, «GODAA aggidi hara eeqa xoossatas goynoy nuuppe haakko!

Gibxe aylleteththa biittafe, nunanne nu aawata kessidi ehiday, he gita malaatata nu sinththan ooththiday, nu biza oge ubbaaninne nu kanththida kawoteththata ubbaa giddon nuna naagiday GODAA nu Xoossaa.
Qasse GODAY he biittan diza Amooretara gujjiin deraa ubbaa nu sinththafe gooddides; hessa gishshas nuni GODAAS goynnana; izi nu Xoossa» gides.
Iyaasoykka deraas, «Intte GODAAS goynnanaas dandayekketa; izi geeshsha Xoossa; izi qanaatiza Xoossa; izi intte makkallateththaanne intte nagaraa atto geenna.
Intte GODAA aggidi allaga xoossatas goynniko izi inttes lo7o ooththidaappe guye simmi wodhdhidi izi intte bolla iita ooththananne inttena dhayssana» gides.
Histtiin derezi Iyaaso, «Akkay nuni GODAAS xalla goynnana» gides.
Hessafe guye Iyaasoy deraas, «Intte GODAAS goynnanaas doorida gishshas intte hu7es intte markka» gides. Isttika zaaridi, «Ee nuni markka!» gida.
Iyaasoy, «Histtiko, intte giddon diza allaga xoossata diggite; intte wozinaa GODAA Isra7eele Xoossaako zaarite» gides.
Derezikka Iyaasos, «Nuni GODAA nu Xoossas goynnana; izaskka azazettana» gida.
He gallas Iyaasoy dereza caaqeththides; istti kaallana wogaanne maara heen Seekeemen isttas immides.
Iyaasoy he qaalata Xoossa Woga Maxaafan xaafides. Hessafe guye issi gita shuch ekkidi Geesh gidida GODAA Dunkaaneza matan diza wola garsan essides.

Iyaasoy kumeththa deraas, «Be7ite; GODAY nuus haasayda qaala ubbaa ha shuchchay siyida gishshas izi nu bolla markka gidana. Intte Xoossa bollan makkalliko ha shuchchay intte bolla markka gidana» gides.
Hessafe guye Iyaasoy deraa ubbaa ba xinxxon xinxxon simmana mala moyzides.
Iyaaso Hayqonne El7ezeere Hayqo
Hessafe guye GODAA aylle, Nawe naa Iyaasos layththay 110 gidiin hayqqides.
Asay Ga7aashe zumaappe pudeha baggan, shaara menththon diza Efreeme deren diza iza xinxxon Teminaate-Seraahan moogides.
Iyaasoy paxa diza wode ubbaan, Iyaasoppe simmiin de7ida asatinne GODAY Isra7eeletas ooththida ooso ubbaa eriza cimati diza wode ubbaan Isra7eele asay GODAAS goynnides.

Isra7eele asay Gibxe biittafe ehida Yooseefe meqeththaa Seekeemen moogida. He sohoza Yaaqoobey Seekeeme aawa Emooreppe 100 saqile biran shammides; histtiin guyeppe Yooseefe zereththatas xinxxo gidides.
Qasseka Aaroone naa El7ezeerey hayqqides; izikka shaara menththon diza Efreeme deren iza naaza Finihaase saaman gakkida Gibi7a katamaan moogettides.
